title: Corporate Event Schema
description: Canonical record schema for corporate events relevant to MSTR equity research (TRACK_A_MSTR_BTC). Primarily for MSTR context and veto research. Covers earnings, SEC filings, capital raises, convertible debt, ATM offerings, equity/debt offerings, share repurchases, stock splits, Bitcoin purchases/dispositions, management changes, and guidance. All records are advisory-only — no trade decision is triggered by a corporate event alone. Point-in-time: the record becomes usable only at available_at_utc. Later amendments create a new revision; amended filings must not rewrite earlier raw evidence. Unknown effective dates remain null rather than inferred.

event_timestamp_utc.description: Primary event timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. The date the event takes effect or was announced, whichever is the primary temporal anchor for this record type.

source_timestamp_utc.description: Provider-asserted timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'.

ingestion_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z', when this record was received and written.

available_at_utc.description: Timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z', at which this record became available for model consumption. The record becomes usable only at available_at_utc. Must be <= announced_at_utc for events usable before the effective date.

revision_number.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter. Later amendments create a new revision. Amended filings must not rewrite earlier raw evidence.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol this event applies to. Upper-case. Primarily MSTR for corporate event research.

event_type.description: Provider-specific event type string. Preserved verbatim for detailed classification within each event_class.

announced_at_utc.description: Date/time the event was first announced or filed in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. For SEC filings, this is the filing acceptance timestamp. Must be <= effective_at_utc when effective_at_utc is known.

effective_at_utc.description: Date/time the event takes effect in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. Nullable — unknown effective dates remain null rather than inferred. Required when known (e.g. ex-dividend date, split effective date).

source_reference.description: Reference to the source document, filing, or press release. Must not contain credentials or authenticated URLs. Format: a stable public URL, EDGAR accession number, or provider-native reference string.

source_document_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source filing/document when available. Required when the source document is obtained and verifiable. Null when the source is not yet available.

materiality_state.description: Materiality classification. MATERIAL_LIKELY = preliminary assessment suggests material impact. MATERIAL_CONFIRMED = confirmed material (e.g. large BTC purchase, convertible offering). IMMATERIAL = routine or de minimis. UNKNOWN = not assessable from available data. Missing or ambiguous material events may result in NO_TRADE.

event_status.description: Current status of the event. ANNOUNCED = filed/announced but not yet effective. EFFECTIVE = effective date has passed and event is in force. COMPLETED = event fully executed (e.g. offering closed). WITHDRAWN = event cancelled. AMENDED = filing was amended — see supersedes_record_id. SUPERSEDED = replaced by a later revision.

supersedes_record_id.description: When this record revises or amends a prior record, the record_id of the prior version. Required when event_status is AMENDED or SUPERSEDED. Amended filings must not rewrite earlier raw evidence — they create a new record pointing back.

summary.description: Concise human-readable summary of the event. Must be sufficient for quick understanding without opening the source document.

structured_attributes.description: Structured event-type-specific attributes. Content varies by event_class. Must not contain credentials, tokens, or authenticated URLs.

btc_transaction_price_usd.description: Average price per BTC in USD.

announcement_before_effective.rule: IF effective_at_utc IS NOT NULL THEN announced_at_utc <= effective_at_utc

available_le_announced.description: Record must be available no later than its announcement date.

timestamps_rfc3339_utc_z.rule: All timestamp fields must end with 'Z'. No offset notation.

no_timestamp_substitution.rule: All timestamp fields must remain distinct with documented meanings.

effective_at_utc_nullable_not_inferred.rule: Unknown effective dates remain null. Do not infer or fabricate effective_at_utc.

amended_does_not_rewrite_raw.rule: IF event_status IN ('AMENDED', 'SUPERSEDED') THEN supersedes_record_id IS NOT NULL. Amended filings must not rewrite earlier raw evidence.

source_reference_no_credentials.rule: source_reference must not contain credentials, API keys, authentication tokens, or authenticated (non-public) URLs.

missing_or_ambiguous_material_no_trade.rule: Missing or ambiguous material events (materiality_state == 'UNKNOWN' with event_class IN critical classes) may result in NO_TRADE for the affected symbol.

no_broker_fields.rule: No broker IDs, order IDs, account IDs, execution IDs, approval IDs, H1 fields, credentials, tokens, or endpoint URLs.

no_scrape_fetch_download.rule: Do not scrape, fetch, or download filings. This schema defines the contract only — no collection is authorized.

track_b_spy_qqq.reason: SPY and QQQ are ETFs; corporate events are not applicable.
